examples.text: [...] produisit un scindage de train en trois parties et de nombreuses avaries aux véhicules. [...]
examples.translation: … produced a splitting of the train into three parts and numerous damages to the vehicles. …
examples.english: … produced a splitting of the train into three parts and numerous damages to the vehicles. …

examples.text: Ce scindage s'opère le plus facilement en certains endroits déterminés du corps, notamment dans le canal intestinal.
examples.translation: The splitting takes place most easily in certain places of the body, notably in the intestinal tract.
examples.english: The splitting takes place most easily in certain places of the body, notably in the intestinal tract.

examples.text: Un tel scindage est une connection linéaire sur L.
examples.translation: Such a splitting is a linear connection on L.
examples.english: Such a splitting is a linear connection on L.

examples.text: Pour un groupe algébrique semi-simple simplement connexe sur un corps algébriquement clos de caractéristique positive, nous avons précédemment construit un scindage de l’endomorphisme de Frobenius sur son algèbre des distributions.
examples.translation: For a simply connected semisimple algebraic group over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, we have already constructed a splitting of the Frobenius endomorphism on its algebra of distributions.
examples.english: For a simply connected semisimple algebraic group over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, we have already constructed a splitting of the Frobenius endomorphism on its algebra of distributions.
